Package solvers.multiSolverAlgorithms

package solvers.multiSolverAlgorithms
Multiclass solution algorithms of JMVA: exact MVA, RECAL, MoM, CoMoM, TreeMVA and TreeConvolution for closed multiclass models, together with their approximate variants.
  • Related Packages
    Package

    solvers
    Solution algorithms of JMVA.
  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    SolverMultiClosedAQL
    This class implements the AQL (Aggregated Queue Length) algorithm for solving multi-closed models
    SolverMultiClosedBardSchweitzer
    This class implements the Bard-Schweitzer algorithm for solving multi-closed models
    SolverMultiClosedChow
    This class implements the AQL (Aggregated Queue Length) algorithm for solving multi-closed models
    SolverMultiClosedLinearizer
    This class implements the Linearizer and De Souza-Muntz Linearizer algorithms for solving multi-closed models
    SolverMultiClosedMonteCarlo
    Solves a multiclass closed model with the Monte Carlo algorithm, an exact technique that estimates the normalizing constants of large models by sampling, as described in the JMVA chapter of the JMT user manual.
    SolverMultiClosedMonteCarloLogistic
    Solves a multiclass closed model, using Monte Carlo Logistic algorithm.
    SolverMultiClosedMVA
    Solves a multiclass closed model with the exact MVA (Mean Value Analysis) algorithm [RL80].
    SolverMultiClosedRGF
    Solves a multiclass closed model with the RGF (Recursive Gaussian Filter) algorithm, an exact solution technique available in JMVA for closed product form queueing networks.
    SolverMultiClosedTreeConvolution
    Solves a multiclass closed model with the exact TreeConvolution algorithm, the tree based version of the convolution algorithm, which reduces the time and space requirements of the exact solution for models with large dimensions.
    SolverMultiClosedTreeMVA
    Solves a multiclass closed model with the exact TreeMVA algorithm [TS85], the tree based version of the Mean Value Analysis, which reduces the time and space requirements of the exact solution for models with large dimensions.
    SolverMultiMixed
    Solves a multiclass mixed model, with both open and closed customer classes, combining the open model algorithms and the exact MVA algorithm as described in the JMVA chapter of the JMT user manual.
    SolverMultiMixedPrioMVA
    Priority MVA solution algorithm of JMVA for mixed models with priority classes.
    SolverMultiMixedRWA
    Reduced Work Rate Approximation
    SolverMultiOpen
    Solves a multiclass open model with the classical queueing network algorithms, as described in the JMVA chapter of the JMT user manual (load dependent stations are not allowed in open models).
